description: Persona seed presets for the CI avatar pipeline. Each entry drives one `blender --background --python generate_avatar.py -- ...` invocation via batch.sh. `seed` makes HumGen randomization reproducible; `height` is metres; `emit` is a comma list of formats. Skin/hair/clothing are advisory hints for the HumGen randomizers once the verified HumGen API wiring lands (see humgen.py TODOs).
